items.summary: Multimodal access to the UCSF Clinical Data Warehouse through natural language. One-call cohort building across diagnoses, medications, procedures, labs, radiology/imaging, immunizations, allergies, and vitals; clinical-notes/NLP search; read-only queries, schema discovery, and structured results. 28 tools, including durable query jobs for long exports. Requires UCSF network credentials (CAMPUS\username and password).

history.note: first release: live R session bridge on gptr
reports a reused gptr server's real mode and tools, states the edits mode exactly, one floor (gptr 1.0; plan mode 1.2), and says which side is behind on a format mismatch
the plan-mode overview lists the session's objects on gptr 1.2.0, not the empty scratch environment each call runs in

the bridge moved into the gptr package repository (Broccolito/gptr) and is released with gptr, under gptr's version; 1.3.1 corrects the permission mode wording of the attach helper and the setup message (serving with no mode named takes gptr's default, auto from gptr 1.3.0, not read-only) and credits the lab in NOTICE: Made by the Baranzini Lab (Wanjun Gu, UCSF)

items.summary: Work inside an R session you already have open. Biorouter inspects, analyses, plots and fixes objects in memory through gptr, without reloading data, and every call passes gptr's permission settings. Private: a public model never sees your session. 3 tools and a bundled gptr-live-r skill. Needs R with the gptr package (1.0 or later) and uv.

overlaps_builtin.boundary: Biorouter Copilot is the first choice for desktop control; this fallback covers systems and apps Copilot does not support, such as Linux with at-spi2-core older than 2.52

history.note: first release: Open Computer Use 1.1.5 behind Biorouter consent
the macOS permission window points at System Settings' + button, since macOS 26 no longer takes a drop onto the permission list, and the permission check reports only the two grants
a click on the permission window's app tile shows the app in Finder instead of being read as a drag

items.summary: A fallback for desktop control where the built-in Biorouter Copilot does not work, for example Linux with at-spi2-core older than 2.52 (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Rocky 9) or an app whose controls Copilot cannot read. Try Copilot first. Built on Open Computer Use 1.1.5 (MIT); asks once per chat before it acts. macOS 14 or later, Windows x64, and Linux on X11. 12 tools. Needs Biorouter 1.94.6 or later.
